what: 1.93.1 scope split --wire on the S1-S10 ledger: ingest refused 4 times. (1) S1 worker always lists .env.example as a ticket context path, which the validator rejects, although the prompt's own existing tickets name it. (2) Without S1, 9 stages produced 197 tickets but 2 file-ownership conflicts within a wave: per-stage workers cannot see shared files (src/app/layout.tsx, api/requests/route.ts, dashboard/page.tsx, dashboard/layout.tsx) that integration tickets of other stages also write.
rule: A wire split must chain or merge integration tickets that edit the same shared file across stages, and must not reject .env.example as context when its own prompt shows it.
fix: Runner: after collecting per-stage wire tickets, add dependsOn chains between tickets sharing a file in order of stage; map .env.example to env.example.txt or allow it read-only; make --wire skip stages whose requirements are all done.
